heroDescription: We use our own AI and global creator data to help brands find the right creators. Our team then manages communication, content coordination and project reviews.
platformCaption: Creators across four leading social platforms.
serviceTitle:
You set the direction.
We make it happen.
serviceIntro: Tell us your goals, markets and budget. Influx develops the plan, finds creators, coordinates partnerships and follows content through to publication. You approve the direction and final creator selection.
service0Desc: We learn about your brand, audience and target markets, then build a marketing plan.
service1Desc: We assess creators’ audiences and engagement, recommend a shortlist and handle creator communication.
service2Desc: We follow up on content production and publishing against your approved direction and schedule.
service3Desc: We keep brands and creators informed, handle collaboration details and track project progress.
quoteDescription: We start with your goals, markets and budget, then agree on the scope and fee.
visionDescription: We help brands understand people, content and communities across markets, and find creators who truly fit.
networkDesc: From emerging talent to leading creators, across markets and platforms.
capIntro: The Influx team uses its own tools to find creators, analyse data and manage projects.
cap0Desc: Describe the creators you need in a sentence, then filter by platform, market and category.
cap1Desc: Compare audience profiles, engagement rates and follower growth to assess potential creators.
cap2Desc: Keep goals, collaboration terms and key dates together, and check project progress at any time.
cap3Desc: Understand brands and categories in their markets to inform campaign direction and creator selection.
capNote: AI creator search and creator search & analysis are available through Plus. Campaign management and brand insights are not included.
